echo_blast.title: Echo Blast
echo_blast.concept: In Echo Blast, you control a spherical robot that can absorb and redirect energy blasts to destroy incoming enemies and obstacles, while navigating a futuristic cityscape. As you progress through levels, the city's environment and enemy types change, requiring you to adapt your strategy and reflexes.

burst_blitz.title: Burst Blitz
burst_blitz.concept: In Burst Blitz, players control a high-speed car that must navigate through a futuristic city, collecting power-ups and dodging obstacles while racing against the clock.
